name: qfx-wow-addon-ui-plugin
description: Reusable Codex skill for designing and refactoring World of Warcraft addon UIs with Blizzard-native controls, compact multilingual width-aware layout, modular architecture, safe font/media handling, SavedVariables migration, event/OnUpdate discipline, modification traceability, minimal-diff reporting, centered slider value layout, compact textless color swatch selectors, duplicate-control avoidance, QFX layout conventions, localization, large-list/sound UI rules, complex addon UI patterns, singleton scrollable dropdowns, batched refresh, packaging checks, performance, and taint-safety checks.

interface.longDescription: Guides Codex to design, review, and refactor World of Warcraft addon interfaces using native Blizzard-style controls, compact multilingual width-aware layout rules, compact textless color swatch selectors, duplicate-control avoidance, modular architecture, safe font/media handling, SavedVariables migration, event/OnUpdate discipline, modification traceability, minimal-diff reports, risk/rollback summaries, unified QFX layout rules including centered slider values, localization, large-list and sound/TTS UI guidance, complex addon UI patterns, singleton scrollable dropdowns, batched refresh, packaging checks, performance checks, and Retail 12.x secret-value/taint safety.
defaultPrompt: Use QFX WoW Addon UI to refactor this add-on settings panel into a Blizzard-native unified layout using the existing UI factory.
Use QFX WoW Addon UI to compact this settings page, account for English/zhCN/zhTW label length, and fully use the available template width without overflow.
Use QFX WoW Addon UI to remove duplicate controls with the same effective function unless their scopes are clearly different.
Use QFX WoW Addon UI to replace labeled color buttons with compact textless swatches that open the color picker and update immediately.
Use QFX WoW Addon UI to review this WoW add-on UI for layout drift, custom controls, localization gaps, taint risk, performance problems, and packaging completeness.
Use QFX WoW Addon UI to fix this saved voice collection UI: selection, drag-out behavior, long sound picker, TTS test path, and large-list refresh performance.
Use QFX WoW Addon UI to apply complex addon UI patterns: singleton scrollable dropdowns, large-list row reuse, batched refresh, stable drag/drop identity, and language-safe editor dialogs.
Use QFX WoW Addon UI to prepare release notes and a package checklist for this QFX add-on.
Use QFX WoW Addon UI to modularize this addon without creating a second architecture, and add safe DB migration and media fallback rules.
Use QFX WoW Addon UI to make this change with minimal diff and provide a traceable report: changed files, risk level, rollback notes, TOC/SavedVariables impact, and in-game tests.
